title: ChatGPT Weekly Active Users Approach 1 Billion: 7 Months Late but Launched in Less Than Four Years

content_html:
According to internal disclosures from OpenAI, the weekly active users of its chatbot ChatGPT are about to exceed 1 billion. This milestone was originally planned to be achieved by the end of last year, although it is seven months late, it is still one of the fastest-growing products in the global internet application market, as it has accumulated such a user base within less than four years since its launch. The company's spokesperson did not comment on this.

The milestone that was seven months late, the growth engine is shifting gears

There are multiple factors contributing to the slowdown in ChatGPT's user growth. Google's Gemini continues to deeply integrate with search engines that have billions of users, gradually eroding the market from the traffic entry point; the development process of GPT-5, launched last autumn, was fraught with difficulties, and after its release, it faced widespread criticism from a large number of users, directly dragging down the growth curve.

Additionally, data from multiple research institutions show that Anthropic's Claude chatbot has also captured some market share since then. A total of 1 billion users is indeed a strong performance, but the seven-month delay also reveals a reality: the first-mover advantage of ChatGPT is being rapidly diluted, and the AI chatbot market is moving from a monopoly to a multi-player competition.

content_html_zh:
据OpenAI内部披露，其聊天机器人ChatGPT的周活跃用户即将突破10亿。 这一里程碑原本计划在去年年底实现，尽管晚了七个月，但它仍然是全球互联网应用市场增长最快的产品之一，因为它在推出不到四年的时间里就积累了这样的用户基础。 该公司发言人没有对此发表评论。

迟到了七个月的里程碑，增长引擎正在换档

ChatGPT 用户增长放缓的因素有多种。 谷歌的Gemini不断与拥有数十亿用户的搜索引擎深度融合，从流量入口逐步蚕食市场；去年秋天推出的GPT-5的开发过程可谓困难重重，发布后又面临大量用户的广泛批评，直接拖累了增长曲线。

此外，多个研究机构的数据显示，Anthropic 的 Claude 聊天机器人此后也占领了一些市场份额。 总共10亿用户确实是一个强劲的表现，但7个月的延迟也揭示了一个现实：ChatGPT的先发优势正在被迅速稀释，AI聊天机器人市场正在从垄断走向多方竞争。
